Name: Main Flight Controller
Description: Primary flight control unit based on STM32H753, includes integrated IMU (ICM-20689) and barometer (MS5611) for stable flight and navigation.

Name: Main Propulsion Motor
Description: Brushless DC motor for forward propulsion.

Name: Motor Electronic Speed Controller
Description: Electronic Speed Controller for the main brushless motor, handling high current for propulsion.

Name: Long Range Radio Link (TX/RX)
Description: Encrypted low-latency digital control and video link transceiver.

Name: GPS Module
Description: Provides global positioning data for navigation.

Name: Airspeed Sensor
Description: Measures drone's speed through the air for improved fixed-wing flight control.

Name: Power Management Module
Description: Power distribution board and voltage/current sensor for the flight controller and ESCs.

Name: Main Wing
Description: Primary lift surface for long-range flight. Typically foam core with composite skin.

Name: Fuselage Body
Description: Main body of the UAV, houses electronics and battery.

Name: Horizontal Stabilizer
Description: Provides pitch stability for the UAV.

Name: Vertical Stabilizer
Description: Provides yaw stability for the UAV.

Name: Main Propeller
Description: Propeller for main propulsion motor.

Name: Left Aileron Servo
Description: Controls the left aileron for roll control.

Name: Right Aileron Servo
Description: Controls the right aileron for roll control.

Name: Elevator Servo
Description: Controls the elevator for pitch control.

Name: Rudder Servo
Description: Controls the rudder for yaw control.

Name: Left Aileron Control Horn
Description: Connects servo pushrod to left aileron.

Name: Right Aileron Control Horn
Description: Connects servo pushrod to right aileron.

Name: Elevator Control Horn
Description: Connects servo pushrod to elevator.

Name: Rudder Control Horn
Description: Connects servo pushrod to rudder.

Name: Left Aileron Pushrod
Description: Transfers motion from servo to left aileron.

Name: Right Aileron Pushrod
Description: Transfers motion from servo to right aileron.

Name: Elevator Pushrod
Description: Transfers motion from servo to elevator.

Name: Rudder Pushrod
Description: Transfers motion from servo to rudder.

Name: Main Motor Mount
Description: Mounts the main propulsion motor to the fuselage firewall.

Name: Flight Controller Mount
Description: Securely holds the flight controller inside the fuselage, reducing vibration.

Name: Flight Battery Tray
Description: Secures the high-capacity Li-ion battery within the fuselage.

Name: ESC Mount
Description: Provides a secure and ventilated mounting point for the ESC.

Name: Long Range RX Mount
Description: Mounts the long-range radio receiver securely inside the fuselage.

Name: GPS Module Mount
Description: Positions the GPS module for optimal signal reception, often externally.

Name: Airspeed Sensor Mount
Description: Mounts the pitot tube for the airspeed sensor at the front of the wing or fuselage.

Name: Power Management Module Mount
Description: Secures the power management module within the fuselage.

Name: Wing Attachment Mechanism
Description: Hardware for securing the main wing to the fuselage, often bolts and nuts.

Name: Fuselage Hatch Cover
Description: Provides access to internal electronics and battery compartment.

Name: Front Landing Skid
Description: Protects the front fuselage during belly landings.

Name: Rear Landing Skid
Description: Protects the rear fuselage/tail during belly landings.

Name: M3x10mm Mounting Screws
Description: General purpose screws for mounting various components.

Name: M3 Nuts
Description: Used with M3 screws for secure fastening.
